title: Version Update - Adding Water to RBC 96-Well Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish Slot
Corning 96 Well Plate 360 µL Flat Slot
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol package
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package, which contains the custom labware definition JSON files for the glass trough (Electron Microscopy Sciences), Omegaquant 96‑Well Plate, Blood Tube Rack, and 200 µL Tip Rack, as well as the reservoir and plate definitions.

steps.title: Upload labware definition
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons OT‑2 App (Version 3.19.0 or later), upload the custom labware definition JSON files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the generated protocol file (updated from Opentrons API Version 1 to Version 2) into the OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the deck exactly as the map specifies.

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: Electron Microscopy Sciences Rectangular Staining Dish.
Mount the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette on the Left mount.

steps.title: Set customizable parameters
steps.instruction: Using the customizations field in the protocol, define the experimental parameters.

substeps.instruction: Select the column from which tip pickup should start.
Specify the number of samples to process per run.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT‑2 App to calibrate all labware, the tip rack, and the P300‑Multi pipette.

substeps.instruction: Calibrate the positions of each labware piece.
Calibrate the tip‑rack height and tip‑pickup offsets.
Calibrate the pipette plunger and tip‑ejection.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to execute the protocol that adds water to the RBC 96‑Well Plate.
